test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental right in the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Right to Acquire Property**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Right to Acquire Property**:

 
 
• This is **not a fundamental right** in the current Constitution of India.
 
 
 
• Originally, the right to property was a fundamental right under **Article 31**, but the **44th Amendment Act of 1978** removed it from the list of fundamental rights.
 
• It was then made a **legal right** under **Article 300A** in Part XII of the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Equality**: Covered under **Articles 14-18**, this right ensures equality before the law, prohibition of discrimination, and equality of opportunity in public employment.
 
• **Right to Freedom**: Covered under **Articles 19-22**, this right includes freedoms like speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, and the right to practice any profession.
 
• **Right to Constitutional Remedies**: Covered under **Article 32**, this is considered the "heart and soul of the Constitution" as it allows individuals to approach the Supreme Court or High Courts to enforce their fundamental rights.
